2027 BMW X3 M50 Adds Horsepower and a Sinister Appearance Package

MR
By Marco Rossi Senior Supercar & Aerodynamics Editor • via Car and Driver Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Car and Driver Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • The 2027 BMW X3 is adopting an ominous look thanks to a new optional Black Package.
  • The limited-edition package will only be available for the 2027 X3 M50 xDrive.
  • The package comes with exclusive 22-inch Jet Black wheels, one inch larger than the wheels offered for the standard lineup.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • MARCO ROSSI Senior Supercar & Aerodynamics Editor

The Benchmark for Track-Tolerant Engineering

In the high-stakes supercar arena, pure horsepower is no longer enough to claim supremacy. This dispatch from Car and Driver emphasizes how cutting-edge downforce balance, electronic limited-slip differentials, and hybrid torque-vectoring are reshaping driver engagement. Exotic marques must prove that extreme performance can harmonize with reliability, thermal endurance, and road compliance.

Big Picture: Lap times at benchmark proving grounds and early client allocations will reveal whether this performance envelope disrupts the existing supercar hierarchy.

The 2027 BMW X3 is adopting an ominous look thanks to a new optional Black Package. The limited-edition package will only be available for the 2027 X3 M50 xDrive.

📌 The Core Development

The package comes with exclusive 22-inch Jet Black wheels, one inch larger than the wheels offered for the standard lineup. It also comes with gloss black brake calipers finished with a monochrome M logo. The high-gloss M logo is repeated around the X3 M50’s exterior and sports a silver outline to make the badges stand out against the dark backdrop.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

Inside, Black Package-equipped X3s feature black Alcantara over the instrument panel, dashboard, center console, door trim, and around the wireless charger. The trim is finished in an aluminum-carbon mix, while the only pop of color is thanks to blue stitching and piping in the seats and the addition of the M colors on the seatbelts and floor mats.
